blocks.label: Opening
blocks.guidance: Acknowledge the recent event in one clean sentence as the reason for writing now.

blocks.label: Body
blocks.guidance:
Build the paragraph around {observation}. That sentence is the one thing you know about this company that you could not say about any other, so it is the reason the email exists. Say it plainly, in your own words, as something you noticed rather than a diagnosis you are delivering.

Then connect it to your background in one continuous thought, not two parallel clauses. If nothing in your background genuinely connects, say why the observation interested you and stop there. That is a better email than a manufactured link.

blocks.label: Close
blocks.text: I'd happily start by owning a real problem for you. Open to a quick chat to see if there is a fit? :)

style.notes: Warm, deferential, and collaborative. Avoid presumptuous or 'know-it-all' tone.
examples: Having judged companies from the investor side and also built sourcing pipelines and automation for private markets myself, Example SaaS really stood out to me. I'd be curious how a real enterprise is solving a problem I have personally spent a lot of time on. As you onboard more private market funds to your platform, my background in building and investing could be a useful combination.
